cohort: The study included 197 non-pregnant women, 168 nulliparous pregnant women, and 124 multiparous pregnant women.
finding: Personality traits (perfectionism and intolerance of uncertainty) were primary determinants of FOC in non-pregnant and nulliparous pregnant women, while previous childbirth experience (emergency caesarean section) was key for multiparous women, and preparedness for childbirth was associated with FOC across all groups.
mod_finding: Previous childbirth experience, specifically emergency caesarean section, was identified as an important determinant of Fear of Childbirth in multiparous women.
cross-section timing: At a single point in time, including non-pregnant, nulliparous pregnant, and multiparous pregnant women.
